name: SlidingDoorPanels
job: Cover a photo with frosted-glass panels in slim graphite frames that slide apart to reveal the next image, one panel at a time in a rhythm
visitor_action: click the arrows or let it auto-advance; swipe on touch; arrow keys browse when focused
motion: panels glide apart staggered with a spring-settle ease and a soft rattle in the track on arrival; closed beat shows the photo ghosting through frosted glass (reduced-motion: leaves stay parked, photos crossfade)
art_direction: Architectural glass wall: slim graphite frames with pale hairlines, matte frosted panels with fine mullions riding a thin track, caption on a quiet scrim, and a tidy control bar with an elegant counter below the image
